title: Pin CrewCraft's release public key in the source
spec: crewcraft_update::ed25519::PINNED_RELEASE_KEYS lists the public halves of CrewCraft's release keys as 64 lowercase hex characters, 1 to MAX_RELEASE_KEYS of them, all distinct and valid; it holds release key 1 (4e80d59d...b32f2bf, made 2026-11-24). pinned_release_keys() is them as a ReleaseKeys SignatureCheck, which refuses a signature no pinned key made. docs/RELEASE.md records the pinned key, how to rotate it, and where the private key is kept.
